description.value: Royal Zayka is a sit-down Indian restaurant on Marine Avenue in Powell River serving authentic North Indian and Mughalai cuisine, including tandoori specialties, a wide range of curries, and house-made breads. The restaurant has received 'Best Indian Restaurant' recognition from Rogers Media and offers dine-in, takeout, delivery, and catering. Touring cyclists will find a substantial menu with dedicated vegetarian dishes and gluten-free curry options.

address.value: 6275 Marine Ave, Powell River, BC V8A 4K6
